transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here today because I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad for a really long time now. It has been going on constantly for about two years and three months, and I just can't seem to shake this heavy, low mood.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful life event or major change, or did they come on without a clear trigger?

I'm not really sure of any specific trigger or stressful event that started these feelings. They seemed to just come on without a clear cause, though I've been feeling this way for about two years and three months now.
During these past two years, have there been any periods lasting two months or longer when you felt mostly back to normal, or has the low mood been there nearly every day the whole time?
No, there haven't been any breaks at all. The low mood has been there nearly every single day for the entire two years. I honestly can't remember a single period where I felt back to normal.
During this time, have you also had symptoms like major changes in sleep or appetite, low energy, poor concentration, feelings of worthlessness, or loss of interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yes, I've definitely lost interest in the things I used to enjoy, and my concentration has been quite poor lately. However, I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep, appetite, or feelings of worthlessness.
Have there been times during these two years when your depression became much worse for at least two weeks at a time, with more symptoms than usual?

I'm not really sure about that. My low mood has felt pretty constant and persistent over the last two years, without any specific two-week periods where it suddenly got much worse. It has just been a steady, heavy feeling the whole time.
Along with the depressed mood, have you had low energy or fatigue on most days during these two years?
No, I haven't really experienced physical fatigue or low energy during this time. That hasn't really been a main issue for me.
On most days during these two years, have you often felt hopeless about the future?
I'm not really sure about that, to be honest. I haven't really thought about the future in that way.
During these two years, have you often had low self-esteem or felt badly about yourself on most days?
No, I haven't really struggled with low self-esteem or feeling badly about myself during this time. That hasn't been a major issue for me.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to die, hurting yourself, or that life isn’t worth living?

No, I haven't had any thoughts of wanting to die or hurting myself. Instead, I just feel very empty, sad, and emotionally numb most of the time. It feels more like a hollow, flat sensation rather than wanting to end my life.
Over the past two years, have you had trouble sleeping or been sleeping much more than usual on most days?
No, I haven't really noticed any major changes or problems with my sleep. It has remained pretty normal for me throughout this time.
